decision_authority: Explicit user request: user-facing uploaded ZIP should contain only the final content output; no Flashcards Pro app.

rules.archive_root: single deliverable file at the ZIP root; no enclosing directory
rules.allowed_content_example: Universal-v2 TSV for flashcard content imports
do_not_include: Flashcards Pro runtime source or binaries
rules.if_multiple_files_are_technically_essent: Include only genuinely indispensable user-consumable output files; never omit required assets or split/degrade working import schema. State the exception explicitly in handoff.
rules.user_override: If the user expressly requests a full app release, full technical checkpoint, source/audit evidence bundle, or multiple artifacts, honor that scope rather than forcing a one-file archive.

engineering_persistence.support_artifacts_location: Library/Project or a separate internal checkpoint; Git contains compact metadata/hashes
packaging_preflight: Exactly one root-level final output where self-contained
Extracted bytes SHA-256 equal verified content parent
IDs/structure and content counts remain unchanged
Persist full source/QA verification outside user-facing ZIP

relation_to_app_release_contract: Does not change German-Flashcards-Pro complete application release ZIP policy. The mandatory App+Content+Source+Tests+Reports+Docs+Tools release structure applies only when delivering a full app/runtime release, not content-only output.
